channel.title: Malawi - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Malawi, every source cited.

item.title: Lawyer accuses Malawi Law Society of bias
item.description: Counsel Tupochele Mponda says the society has been inconsistent in its criticism of presidential actions.

item.title: Malawi attorney general and law society clash over parliament delay
item.description: The Attorney General and Malawi Law Society interpret the same constitutional clause differently regarding the president's decision.

item.title: Bullets and Wanderers win FDH Bank Premiership matches
item.description: FCB Nyasa Big Bullets beat Masters 2-1 and Mighty Wanderers defeated Goshen City Dedza Dynamos 2-0.

item.title: Malawi cities face unlicensed motorbike rider crisis
item.description: Motorcycle taxis are vital for transport and livelihoods in Lilongwe, Blantyre, Mzuzu and Zomba.

item.title: DPP official threatens Malawi Congress Party director
item.description: Maria Mainja accused Moses Kunkuyu of spreading false rumours about President Mutharika's health.
